label: Learning Type
definition_text: The type of learning opportunity. Always LearningProgram here (the Studio's own column).

label: External Identifier
definition_text: A unique alphanumeric identifier for this learning opportunity that is used for your customers or for internal processes within your system.

label: Name
definition_text: Name or title of the resource.

label: Description
definition_text: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
sample: This course guides students in the development of...

label: Subject Webpage
definition_text: Webpage that describes this entity.

label: Life Cycle Status Type
vocabulary:
Active
Ceased
Ceasing
Developing
Suspended
Teach Out
definition_text: Type of state of the resource in terms of its stage in a life cycle; select from an enumeration of such types.

label: Language
definition_text: The primary language or languages of the entity, even if it makes use of other languages.

label: In Catalog
definition_text: An inventory or listing of resources that includes this resource.

label: Credit Value
definition_text: A credit-related value.

label: Credit Unit Value
definition_text: The value of the property value node.

label: Credit Unit Min Value
definition_text: The lower value of some characteristic or property.

label: Credit Unit Max Value
definition_text: The upper value of some characteristic or property.

label: Is Non-Credit
definition_text: Resource carries or confers no official academic credit according to the provider of the resource.

label: Available At
definition_text: Physical location where the credential, assessment, or learning opportunity can be pursued.

label: Available Online At
definition_text: Online location where the credential, assessment, or learning opportunity can be pursued.

label: Availability Listing
definition_text: Listing of online and/or physical locations where a resource can be found or pursued.

label: Date Effective
definition_text: Date after which this resource is available or applicable.

label: Approximate Date Effective
definition_text: Approximate date after which this resource is available or applicable.

label: Delivery Type
vocabulary:
Asynchronous
Blended Delivery
In Person
Mixed Synchronous
Online Only
Synchronous

definition_text: Type of means by which a learning opportunity or assessment is delivered to credential seekers and by which they interact; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

label: Delivery Type Description
definition_text: Detailed description of the delivery type of an assessment or learning opportunity.
sample: This program includes a mix of delivery types that are designed to fit different schedules.

vocabulary:

Internship
Laboratory

definition_text: Types of methods used to conduct the learning opportunity; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

label: Learning Method Description
definition_text: Description of the methods used to conduct learning.
sample: This program includes experiential and project-based learning methods.

label: Content Description
definition_text: Description of the topics, concepts, theories, and practices addressed by a learning opportunity, program, course or assessment.
sample: Topics covered are mechanical waves, sound, electrostatics, current and DC circuits, magnetism, light and optics, and modern physics.

label: Subject
definition_text: Words or brief phrases describing the topicality of the entity; select subject terms from an existing enumeration of such terms.

label: Entry Condition
definition_text: Requirements for entry into a credentialing program, a learning opportunity, or an assessment, including credentials, transcripts, records of previous experience, or other forms of entry documentation.

label: Entry Condition: Description
definition_text: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
sample: Students who earn a grade point average of 3.0 or higher are eligible to apply.

label: Target Learning Opportunity
definition_text: Learning opportunity that is the focus of a condition, process or another learning opportunity.

label: Estimated Duration
definition_text: Estimated time it will take to complete an activity, event, or resource.
